newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka ends firmer, recovers early loss.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka ends firmer, recovers early loss.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka recovered from an early fall and finished above Monday's level in interbank trading on Tuesday after sellers softened their offer rates.
Dealers said the taka ended at 44.2000/2030 to the dollar against the previous close of 44.2020/2050.
The local unit opened at 44.1990/2100 per dollar but edged up later after sellers softened their stance amid demand for dollars from importers.
"But there were not many transactions," said one dealer.
Call money was traded at 7.0-7.5 percent against a previous 7.5 to 8.0 percent.
